visualCharacteristics: Interactive prior-authorization lookup tool: a Market select, a dependent Line of Business select, a drug/CPT/HCPCS typeahead input, a validation-gated Search button, and a dynamically rendered results area.
contentPattern: Config rows (key | value): 'Data Source' → published JSON path; 'Markets' → market list; one row per market → its Line-of-Business options. All rows optional; the block renders a usable shell and performs client-side search when a data source is configured.
usage: Prior-authorization requirement lookup on the prior-authorization-lookup page. Custom interactive block (NOT the boilerplate form block).
